Name: Heldai
Summary: Heldai was one of the exiles from Babylon who brought silver and gold to Jerusalem for the crowning of Joshua the high priest (Zechariah 6:10). He appears again in Zechariah 6:14 under the variant name Helem.
KeyStory: Heldai, with Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Josiah son of Zephaniah, brought gifts from Babylon for the crown placed on Joshua's head.
RelatedPeople: Tobijah; Jedaiah; Josiah, Son of Zephaniah
LifeLesson: Heldai carried his wealth home to crown another man. The best use of exile's gains is the glory of the house of God.
